name: Mem
description: Mem lets agents search, read, and create notes and organize them in collections. Each user signs in to their own Mem account through the browser.

prompts.text: Find my notes about the Q3 planning meeting and summarize them.
Create a note with the action items from this conversation.
List the notes in my Research collection from the last month.

apps.name: Mem
apps.description: Note search, reading, note creation, and collections, over Mem's MCP server with browser sign-in.
